Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.input

Interface PlayerInput

All Known Implementing Classes:
PlayerOrders
public interface PlayerInput
What the user asks the player to do, whatever the device (keyboard, gamepad, a scripted fake in tests). The core only knows this interface, never the keys (Q100).

  • Method Details

    • moveDirection

      com.badlogic.gdx.math.Vector2 moveDirection()
      Returns the direction the user wants to walk in.
      Returns:
      a new vector, safe to change; (0, 0) to stand still, at most 1 long for full speed

    • attackPoint

      Optional<com.badlogic.gdx.math.Vector2> attackPoint()
      Returns the point of the world the user attacks towards, while they ask to attack (the left button held on desktop). The player attacks as soon as it can, aiming from its centre to it.
      Returns:
      a new vector in world pixels, safe to change; empty while the user does not attack

    • wantsPickUp

      boolean wantsPickUp()
      Tells whether the user holds the pickup key (GDD 1.4). The player picks up once per press.
      Returns:
      true while the key is held

    • hotbarSlot

      int hotbarSlot()
      Returns the hotbar slot the user selected (keys 1, 2, 3): the one the use key uses.
      Returns:
      the slot, from 0 to Inventory.HOTBAR_SIZE - 1

    • wantsToUse

      boolean wantsToUse()
      Tells whether the user holds the use key (GDD 1.4). The player uses one consumable per press.
      Returns:
      true while the key is held

    • wantsDash

      boolean wantsDash()
      Tells whether the user holds the dash key (GDD 2.4, Q40). The player dashes once per press.
      Returns:
      true while the key is held

    • wantsDodgeRoll

      boolean wantsDodgeRoll()
      Tells whether the user holds the dodge roll key (GDD 2.4, Q40). The player rolls once per press.
      Returns:
      true while the key is held
